|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[TIE Sentry Ships (V) (Virtual Block 6)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-49-TIE_Sentry_Ships-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 6 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[TIE Sentry Ships (V) (Virtual Block 6)]].
* '''Original''' ([[TIE Sentry Ships (V) (Virtual Block 6)]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “USED: If you just drew a unique (•) Imperial starship for destiny, take that starship into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve a unique (•) Imperial starship into hand.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[TIE Sentry Ships (V) (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “redraw that destiny” to “redraw the destiny”: “USED: If you just drew a unique (•) Imperial starship for destiny, take that starship into hand to cancel and redraw the destiny. LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve a unique (•) Imperial starship into hand.”.<ref name="cl-1261_50-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
